dependencyAcquisition.method: Download root-specific dependency ZIP, preserve parts/, parts/s/, p/, p/48/ hierarchy, record each member metadata/hash and recursively resolve type-1 references. Do not infer license from root, URL path, site footer, or ZIP container.

dependencyAcquisition.missingDependencyPolicy: Fail acquisition and fetch the actual missing official dependency; never replace a missing shape with a primitive placeholder.

licensing.mixedRule: Per CAreadme, modifications dated before 2023-03-05 use CC BY 2.0; modifications on/after that date use CC BY 4.0. Preserve and honor both, not an assumed either/or choice.

materialConfiguration.status: No !LICENSE header observed; not automatically cleared by the licensed DAT records. Site-created-content CC BY4.0 applicability is an inference; preserve LDraw.org attribution and confirm before wholesale redistribution.

runtimeNormalization.threeGltfRecommendation: Keep source assembly transforms in LDU; apply one outer +180-degree X rotation (x,y,z→x,-y,-z) for Y-up and one outer scale only. Do not negate Y alone (reflection), recenter parts individually, or guess their pivots.
runtimeNormalization.materials: Use color16 inheritance and color24 edge semantics; preserve fixed subpart color codes, BFC INVERTNEXT/winding, mirrored transforms, conditional edges and !COLOUR alpha/finish.
runtimeNormalization.dimensionalWarning: LDraw unit-to-mm equivalence is explicitly approximate. This inventory assigns no invented component dimensions.
runtimeNormalization.gltf: Use meters and Y-up after normalization; preserve individual part names/instances and provenance outside the binary too.

conversionOptions.notes: setPartsLibraryPath to the extracted root; preload materials when cleared; setFileMap from resolvedDependencies or pack dependencies into MPD. MPD FILE blocks must preserve consistent reference names and attribution.
